This '''[[Gender/Legends|male]] individual''' served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] during the final decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
This [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individual was inducted into the Jedi Order at an early age and [[Jedi training/Legends|instructed]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] at one of the Order's [[Jedi academy|academies]] before passing his [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Trials of Knighthood]] and ascending to the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], this Jedi took up the rank of [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] within the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and fought throughout the war. During this time, this Jedi was in the process of assembling a documentary on the species represented within the Order. It is unknown how much of the documentary he accomplished by the time of the end of the war, but it is known that death prevented him from completing his work. During the fighting, the Republic's [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] betrayed the Order by issuing [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|Contingency]] [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] to the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] being led by the Jedi Generals in battle. This particular Jedi was one of many to die during the fall of the Order and the Republic.<ref name="FOTJ" />

==Legacy==
While his work was incomplete, it survived the [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|fighting and the fires]] that destroyed much of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] during the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Sequestered away in the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Temple Archives]], the document survived the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and the destruction of the Temple during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. By [[43 ABY]], the Temple had been rebuilt and the Archives restored under the guardianship of the [[New Jedi Order|reformed Jedi Order]], with this Jedi's work still preserved amongst the Stacks. While not listed among searchable records, [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|High Council member]] and [[Jedi healer/Legends|Chief Healer]] [[Cilghal]] discovered the record during a scan of audio files that included the term ''electroencephaloscan''. Investigating, she came across the audio of an interview with long-dead Master [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]]. In the interview he discussed a [[Baran Do]] technique in which they could distort the scan's readings, making them appear brain-dead. This was a vital clue that first sparked the unraveling of the mystery of the bizarre [[Force psychosis|Force Psychosis]] seen in several [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]].<ref name="FOTJ" />
